findings.resolution: RCH exact under-six-month poor-feeding/not-waking hospital advice is separately attributed from NHS under-five not-feeding emergency advice. Queensland explicitly includes weaker/shorter feeds and prompt assessment, not only total refusal. Its exact urgency, age and common RCH upstream are not overstated.

NHS explicitly gives small frequent meals during recovery; ASN p14 corroborates ordinary supportive practice but p3 discloses adapted international material. One clear authoritative source suffices for this unquantified low-risk recovery suggestion; no independent trial efficacy or wholly independent second origin claimed.

resolved_author_questions.question: Small frequent meals are low-risk supportive recovery advice; ASN acknowledges adapted provenance and is not asserted as a wholly independent second evidence origin. Independent review must preserve that distinction.
resolved_author_questions.resolution: This is an evidence-provenance boundary, not an unresolved medical support issue. Retain it in evidence_boundaries; root may clear the pending question when applying this accepted hash-bound review.

evidence_boundaries: Independent editorial review is not clinician sign-off; all medical_reviewed flags remain false.

RCH exact under-six-month hospital advice is a named regional rule; Queensland corroborates prompt feeding-change assessment, not identical cutoff or emergency transport. Queensland acknowledges common RCH material; no independent research replication claimed.
NHS small frequent meals is direct ordinary recovery advice. ASN acknowledges adapted international material and is not a wholly independent underlying source.
IDSA antifungal guidance is selected non-neutropenic ICU candidiasis; SSC2026 is adult sepsis. Shared clinical literature is explicit; no universal child regimen.

Thirteen source objects retain the exact accepted-claim inheritance above; they were not all reopened in this review. Acceptance applies to the bounded uses, not all statements elsewhere on source websites.
resolution: All62 bilingual claims are adequately supported at the lay encyclopedia standard. The single infant binding issue was repaired without changing wording, then rechecked. Current source/section/content hashes match; no remaining substantive medical or evidentiary issue. Pending author status can be resolved by root using this report. ICD scope and deployment are outside this review.
